data.long_meaning: Ayra is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ayu' meaning 'life' and 'Ra' meaning 'joy'. The name symbolizes the mother's joy in having a child. The name Ayra carries the meaning “Mother's joy” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ayra usually hope their child will grow to embody mother's joy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
